summary: Iteration 8 (rider role + portal + real-time tracking + accurate checkout address + GCash QR-missing warning) verified end-to-end on the frontend. All 6 requested flows pass. (F1) Rider login rider.pedro@laguna.ph/rider123 lands on /rider — 'My Deliveries' shows 1 assigned order f9f5e49d (Out for Delivery) with rider-address-<id>='Los Baños, Laguna', Google Maps directions link (google.com/maps/dir), buyer phone/name, and DeliveryMap. mark-delivered-<id> button visible for out_for_delivery status. (F2) share-location-btn click did not crash the page (headless geolocation unavailable — button remained functional). (F3) Registered brand-new rider via /register (role-rider selector shows Buyer/Farmer/Rider; vehicle-input and address-input appear when rider selected). Post-signup navigation → /rider showing 'No deliveries assigned to you yet.' (F4) Buyer aling.nena expanded the out_for_delivery order — delivery-map rendered with 2 leaflet markers (dropoff H + rider R). Buyer Orders page polls every 5s (Orders.jsx L22-30). (F5) /checkout with 'Deliver to me' + map-picker + locate-me-btn: clicking the map dropped a pin (pin-coords='14.203151, 121.224473'), reverse-geocoded via Nominatim and auto-filled the address textarea with 'Los Baños, Laguna, Calabarzon, Philippines'. checkout-shipping updated from ₱115.00 → ₱175.00 after new pin; switching to pickup showed 'Free (pickup)', switching back restored ₱175.00. (F6) /gcash-pay/<Kanor order> shows the amber qr-missing-warning block containing 'No official GCash QR from this seller. The code above is auto-generated for reference only...' as required for seller Kanor (info.qr_url absent). No page/runtime errors on RiderPortal, Orders, Checkout, or GcashPayment. Backend rider chain was already curl-verified by main agent.

issues: Occasionally two transient PAGE-ERR 'Cannot read properties of undefined (_leaflet_pos)' logged when the leaflet map is clicked before tiles finish loading. No user-visible impact — pin still drops, address still auto-fills, and shipping fee still updates. Consider guarding the click handler until map load event fires.

action_items: (Optional) Suppress the harmless leaflet _leaflet_pos error during initial map load by ignoring click events until map.whenReady() fires in MapPicker.jsx.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 828 lines (still past the 700-line split threshold). Splitting into routers/ (auth, products, orders, rider, checkout, shipping, gcash, reviews) is overdue.

RiderPortal `toggleShare` posts rider-location for every active order on every geolocation tick with no throttling — could hammer the API on a fast-moving GPS. Consider min interval (e.g., 3-5s) between PUTs.
Nominatim reverse geocode call in MapPicker.jsx has no debounce and runs on every map click; rapid clicks can trigger Nominatim's rate limit (1 req/s). Debounce or cancel in-flight requests.
MapPicker click handler races with map initialization → intermittent '_leaflet_pos' console errors. Wrap map.on('click', ...) inside map.whenReady().

GcashPayment.jsx qrSrc fallback `${API}/gcash-qr/${orderId}` is only sensible when the seller intentionally has no QR — good that the amber warning now clarifies that to buyers. Consider disabling scanning UI text ('Scan to pay in your GCash app') when info.qr_url is missing since it may confuse users.

Orders.jsx poll runs every 5s per open expanded order but doesn't cancel when the status transitions to 'delivered' — harmless but wasteful (would keep polling forever if user leaves the card open). Add a guard to clear interval when new status !== 'out_for_delivery'.

success_rate.backend: 100% (curl chain already verified by main agent)
